flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No taxi/SMRT-specific code in the six repos (grep smrt, taxi, cab, fleet, comfort, cabcharge = 0). Only the generic company path: ocmseserviceapi workflows/furnish/{FurnishApplicationListController, FurnishValidationServiceImpl}, crud/ocmspii/eocmsoffencenoticeownerdriver (id_type 'B'), ocmseserviceui pages/Furnish/Form/CompanyParticulars + utils/validation/Furnish/ValidCompany; thirdpartyapi has only cesTpApiARelay and axsNopo
note: Story status: User Story Removed, so the verdict stays Removed even though similar code exists. The story asks OCMS to send furnishable notices to a taxi company (SMRT). No code knows taxis/SMRT and there is no outbound interface to a company; only the generic portal exists: a company logs in with Corppass (UEN) and pulls its own furnishable list, with the same conditions as OCMS41.1. So steps that have code are Sebagian only. Related maintenance tickets: none mention taxi/SMRT. Corppass login: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Notices under a company (taxi company) ID are identified by that ID
steps.detail: There is no taxi/SMRT concept in the repo (grep smrt, taxi, cab, fleet, comfort, cabcharge in the six repos = 0 hits). Only the generic path exists: Corppass login produces entityId (UEN), the controller uses idType 'B' (FurnishApplicationListController.java:81-83) and the eONOD query supports id_type='B' (EocmsOffenceNoticeOwnerDriverRepository.java:50-59). It applies to every UEN; there is no taxi-specific list or configuration.

steps.step: Per-notice-type conditions (processing stage, notice status) decide which notices are sent
steps.detail: Same conditions as OCMS41.1 step 6: crs_reason null, not certain PS, not UPL, stage ROV/ENA/RD1/RD2 (FurnishValidationServiceImpl.java:177-182,192,211). Applied to every ID when the list is read, not selected specially for taxis (same fact, same fit as OCMS41.1).

steps.step: OCMS sends the notice list to the taxi company (SMRT) through an interface or channel
steps.detail: thirdpartyapi only contains the cesTpApiARelay and axsNopo workflows (thirdpartyapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/webhookservice/workflows). ocmsadminprivateapi and ocmsadminapi have no job, file export, email or outbound API to a taxi company (grep smrt|taxi = 0); the only furnish notification is the internal daily email to officers (FurnishNotificationServiceImpl.java:48). Notices are pulled by the company at login, not sent.

steps.step: The taxi company receives the notices to furnish hirer/driver particulars
steps.detail: A company logged in with Corppass can see its notices and fill in particulars through the Furnish service (route.ts:38-40; CompanyParticulars.ts:23; ValidCompany.ts:14). This is a pull model through the portal for all companies, not receipt by a taxi company/SMRT. The Corppass handshake: cannot verify from repo.
